maddeler.e:
أتشيطن (form IIq)
# أَتَشَيْطَنُ (ʔatašayṭanu) /ʔa.ta.ʃaj.tˤa.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
# أَتَشَيْطَنَ (ʔatašayṭana) /ʔa.ta.ʃaj.tˤa.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
# أَتَشَيْطَنْ (ʔatašayṭan) /ʔa.ta.ʃaj.tˤan/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَشَيْطَنَ (tašayṭana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
